analyst_view.overall: Early view: Ajax host Utrecht a week after the Klassieker and four days before a Conference League trip to Sint-Truiden. Utrecht went into the break after losing 4-2 at Telstar and 3-2 at home to NEC, with coach Anthony Correia naming set pieces as a big problem, which suits Ajax's aerial threat through Tolu Arokodare.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.5 goals. I lean higher: Utrecht's set-piece defending is poor by their coach's own account, Tolu scores many of Ajax's goals with his head, and Utrecht have conceded seven in two games.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners. I lean slightly higher: Ajax will want corners against a team that struggles to defend them, and Utrecht will likely sit deep after their recent defeats.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.3 cards. No rivalry or bans in the news; Utrecht's pressure may cause some frustration, but that is already in the estimate.

shots.text: The numbers say 31.3 shots. Ajax may rotate before Sint-Truiden, but they should still dominate at home; I keep it.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.7 shots on target. Ajax have finishing quality, and Utrecht scored twice even in defeat to NEC, so I agree.
